name: salesmessage-member
description: Salesmessage web app as a MEMBER — session comes from profile-member/
//profile: a second Chrome profile, so a video can show two users without signing in on camera (no password typed, no 2FA prompt, no reCAPTCHA)

//auth: Sign in to app.salesmessage.com once by hand in profile-member/ as the member; takes never log it out.
